hunger-death.hospital.1: Someone found you collapsed on the floor from low blood sugar... so I gave you an emergency glucose infusion!
darkness-death.hospital.1: Someone found you collapsed on the floor covered in wounds... so I performed emergency surgery on you!
darkness-death.hospital.2: It hasn't been very safe at night lately. Make sure to bring a light source when you go out, and don't stay out too late, okay?
hunger-death.mine.linus.1: ...I found you passed out in the mines from hunger. You were lucky I happened to be passing by and gave you a few Sweet Berries!
hunger-death.mine.linus.2: If you're having trouble in life, come talk to me, okay?
hunger-death.mine.robin.1: ...I found you passed out in the mines from hunger. I thought you were a shriveled-up walking stick!
hunger-death.mine.robin.2: Remember to bring food next time, okay?
hunger-death.mine.clint.1: ...I found you passed out in the mines from hunger. I dragged you all the way here, and you are shockingly light!
hunger-death.mine.clint.2: Even if you're dieting, you need to eat enough before going into the mines. Remember to bring food next time, okay?
hunger-death.mine.maru.1: ...I found you passed out in the mines from hunger. I was looking for minerals and almost didn't see you!
hunger-death.mine.maru.2: Remember to bring more food next time, okay?
hunger-death.mine.maru-spouse.1: ...I found you unconscious in the mines from hunger. You had been gone so long that I started to worry!
hunger-death.mine.maru-spouse.2: Please, please bring more food next time, okay?
hunger-death.island.willy.2: I was so worried... I thought you were so hungry you had to drink seawater to survive! Bring plenty of food when you're out there...
hunger-death.island.willy.3: This island doesn't have food everywhere.
hunger-death.island.leo.2: My bird friends found you and told me you were passed out from hunger, so I dragged you here.
hunger-death.island.leo.3: Please take better care of yourself out there. I don't want to be sad again...

config.enable-hunger-system.name: Enable hunger system (Beta)
config.enable-hunger-system.tooltip: Enable the Hunger system and its gameplay effects. This feature is currently beta.
config.hunger-damage-mode.name: Hunger damage
config.hunger-damage-mode.tooltip: Choose whether Hunger damage is lethal, stops at a non-lethal floor, or is disabled. This does not change Hunger loss or sleep recovery costs.
config.sleep-recovery-balance.name: Sleep recovery balance
config.sleep-recovery-balance.tooltip: When enabled, sleep first applies natural Hunger loss, then pays from the remaining Hunger for shared recovery: 1 Hunger restores 1 Sanity and up to 2 Health. Payment continues until both are full or Hunger runs out. When disabled, vanilla sleep Health recovery is kept.
config.enable-seed-edibility.name: Enable seed edibility
config.enable-seed-edibility.tooltip: Allow eligible crop seeds to be eaten. This setting is applied by the seed food feature.
config.enable-sanity-system.name: Enable Sanity system
config.enable-sanity-system.tooltip: Enable the Sanity system and its gameplay effects.
config.sanity-monster-intensity.name: Sanity monsters
config.sanity-monster-intensity.tooltip: Choose how densely Sanity monsters may appear.
config.dark-hand-mode.name: Dark Hand
config.dark-hand-mode.tooltip: Choose how Dark Hands interact with the world. Thief is a high-risk mode: it can permanently stop an eligible machine and permanently delete its current contents or ready output. Deleted contents cannot be recovered.
config.enable-sanity-visual-effects.name: Low-Sanity filter
config.enable-sanity-visual-effects.tool: Enable the low-Sanity screen filter and its local visual effects.
config.enable-low-sanity-screen-distorti: Enable low-Sanity world drift, screen shake, and localized edge distortion. The low-Sanity color effect remains controlled by Low-Sanity filter.
config.enable-sanity-vignette.name: Vignette
config.enable-sanity-vignette.tooltip: Controls only the normal vignette above 15% Sanity. Below 15%, the Low-Sanity filter switches to the animated low-Sanity vignette; with that filter off, this setting still shows the normal vignette.
config.enable-natural-darkness.name: Darkness
config.enable-natural-darkness.tooltip: Controls the mod's natural-light darkness, mine wall lights, and NPC flashlights. Turning it off restores those original lighting behaviors without changing dawn/dusk music or darkness damage.
config.darkness-damage-mode.name: Darkness damage
config.darkness-damage-mode.tooltip: Choose whether darkness damage is off, capped at a non-lethal floor, or uses the default behavior.
config.monster-difficulty-profile.name: Monster strength
config.monster-difficulty-profile.toolti: Choose a Beta balance profile. Stardew, Compatible, Don't Starve, and Fusion may currently use identical numeric values while balance data is unfinished.
config.enable-junimo-blessing.name: Junimo protection
config.enable-junimo-blessing.tooltip: Protect eligible locations from natural darkness and darkness attacks, and affect the 2:00 pass-out safety route there. This setting does not control nearby Junimo Sanity recovery.
config.enable-danger-minigame-blocking.t: When enabled, block the configured minigames during danger and interrupt multiplayer fishing when a monster actually damages the player. This does not change the Low-Sanity filter.
config.enable-dawn-dusk-music.name: Dawn/dusk music
config.enable-dawn-dusk-music.tooltip: Controls only Don't Starve-style dawn and dusk music. Work, farming, and combat activity music have a separate option.
config.enable-activity-music.name: Activity music
config.enable-activity-music.tooltip: Play Don't Starve-style activity music for work, farming, and combat.
passout.two-am.prompt-a: [DEV PLACEHOLDER] The darkness has noticed you.
passout.two-am.prompt-b: [DEV PLACEHOLDER] Something is moving just beyond the light.
passout.two-am.nonlethal-feedback: [DEV PLACEHOLDER] You barely hold on until morning.
passout.two-am.clinic-recovery: [DEV PLACEHOLDER] You wake up in Harvey's clinic.
passout.two-am.mail.body: [DEV PLACEHOLDER] You were brought to the clinic after being found unconscious last night. Please be more careful after dark. - Harvey[#]A note from Harvey
